title: Waiver, Dispute and Compromise Terms by Debt Type (Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery)
content:
The terms on which the debtor's waiver requests, disputes and compromise offers are taken and decided for each debt type in **Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery**.

| Debt type | Largest debt VA may compromise without the Department of Justice (USD) | Accepted compromise paid in one lump sum within (calendar days of acceptance) | Compromise offer requires a Financial Status Report |
|---|---|---|---|
| Education Overpayment (Chapters 30, 35 and 1606) | 100000.00 | 30 | Yes |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill Housing and Books Overpayment | 100000.00 | 30 | Yes |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill Tuition and Fees Overpayment | 100000.00 | 30 | Yes |
| Disability Compensation Overpayment | 100000.00 | 30 | Yes |
| Veterans Pension Overpayment | 100000.00 | 30 | Yes |
| Home Loan Guaranty Debt | 100000.00 | 30 | Yes |

| Debt type | Waiver requires a Financial Status Report | Fraud, misrepresentation or bad faith finding bars waiver | Committee may waive part of a debt | Amounts collected after a timely waiver request refunded when that portion is waived | Timely dispute holds collection | Only one waiver, dispute or compromise request pending at a time |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Education Overpayment (Chapters 30, 35 and 1606) | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill Housing and Books Overpayment | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill Tuition and Fees Overpayment | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Disability Compensation Overpayment | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Veterans Pension Overpayment | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Home Loan Guaranty Debt | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Points of reading

- The compromise ceiling is a balance test: a debt whose balance is not more than 100000.00 USD is within VA's own compromise authority; a hypothetical balance of 100000.01 USD is not.
- "Timely dispute holds collection" means that a timely dispute of the debt's existence or amount holds collection until it is resolved.
- "Only one pending" covers waiver requests, disputes and compromise offers together, for every debt type.
- These terms are identical across the six debt types; the debt type does not change any of them.
